sentences.en: Examining function of salivary and lacrimal gland or sialography as well as lower lip biopsy is necessary for the diagnosis.

sentences.en: In our country, the conventional parotid sialography is still considered as the first imaging examination in diagnosing SS.

sentences.en: MR sialography is the best imaging test if Sjogren's syndrome is suspected because of its ability to accurately stage the severity of the disease.
sentences.vi: Chụp cắt lớp vi tính MR là xét nghiệm hình ảnh tốt nhất nếu nghi ngờ hội chứng Sjogren vì khả năng xác định chính xác mức độ nghiêm trọng của bệnh.

sentences.en: Materials and Methods: Parotid sialography was performed in 87 patients with SS. The abnormal changes of parotid duct were analysed.

sentences.en: PURPOSE : To evaluate the diagnostic value of magnetic resonance sialography ( MRS ) for chronic obstructive parotitis ( COP ).
